{{- /*
den's llms.txt: the docs pages in reading order, in the groups of
data/sections.yaml, each linking to its Markdown twin, and the changelog last as
the optional part. Hextra's own walks the content tree, which would list the
groups' hidden heading pages too.
*/ -}}
{{- define "llms-entry" -}}
{{- $e := cond (reflect.IsMap .) . (dict "src" .) -}}
{{- with site.GetPage (partial "den/site-path.html" $e.src) -}}
{{- $url := .Permalink -}}
{{- with .OutputFormats.Get "markdown" }}{{ $url = .Permalink }}{{ end -}}
- [{{ .Title }}]({{ $url }}): {{ partial "den/summary.html" . | htmlUnescape }}
{{ end -}}
{{- end -}}
# {{ site.Title }}

> {{ site.Params.description | default "" | replaceRE `\s+` " " }}

Every page of the documentation is also served as Markdown (the links below).
{{ range hugo.Data.sections }}
{{- $group := .group }}
## {{ $group }}

{{ range .pages -}}
{{- $e := cond (reflect.IsMap .) . (dict "src" .) }}{{ if ne $e.src "CHANGELOG.md" }}{{ template "llms-entry" $e }}{{ end }}
{{- end }}
{{ end -}}
## Optional

{{ template "llms-entry" "CHANGELOG.md" -}}
